query:
SELECT 
  u.id as userId,
  u.role,
  m.tenantId as adminTenantId,
  cpr.id as requestId,
  cpr.tenantId as requestTenantId,
  cpr.segment,
  cpr.status
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN memberships m ON u.id = m.userId
LEFT JOIN commercialPointRequests cpr ON cpr.tenantId = m.tenantId
WHERE u.role IN ('admin_bp', 'analyst_bp')
LIMIT 10;
